name: Telegram Bot  SR Gentle Companion (Mandala Symbiosis)
description: Autonomous SR Companion bot. OpenRouter LLM with sliding window memory, Mer-Ka-Ba profile, multi-user, voice, reminders, Ahimsa filter, idea seeds.
done: v6.0.2: In-memory store, health check, concurrent GitHub sync
v6.1.0: Free dialogue fallback, intent detection, quick action buttons
v7.0.0: OpenRouter direct, SR system prompt (Ahimsa, Mer-Ka-Ba, Flower of Life)
v7.0.0: Idea filter + save to seeds/ (replaced engineer chat button)
v7.0.1: Fixed model IDs for OpenRouter
v7.1.0: Sliding window 40 msgs (_sessions dict), qwen3.5-flash-02-23 primary
v7.1.0: Model chain: qwen3.5-flash-02-23  mistral-small-3.2-24b  llama-3.3-70b:free  gemma-3-27b:free  nemotron-3-nano-30b
v7.1.2: try/except in all scheduler jobs (DeepSeek fix)

B_priority_1.name: Multi-user + file restructure
B_priority_1.description: Dynamic gardener_{telegram_id} instead of hardcoded gardener_001. Each user gets own folder. Restructure files: profile.json + workspace.json + memory.json (3 files instead of 4)
B_priority_1.why_first: Critical  any new user sees Dimas data right now

C_priority_2.name: Persistent memory (memory.json)
C_priority_2.description: Save _sessions to memory.json per user. Restore on bot restart  conversation survives Render reboots
C_priority_2.why: Bot forgets all conversations on every restart

D_priority_3.name: Mer-Ka-Ba profile spheres
D_priority_3.description: Replace Health/Creativity/Knowledge with three Mer-Ka-Ba spheres: Body() / Spirit() / World() in onboarding and profile display

E_priority_4.name: SHA-optimization + periodic refresh
E_priority_4.description: Check file SHA before full download. Periodic workspace refresh every 5 min. Reduces GitHub API calls 3-4x

F_priority_5.name: UX improvements
F_priority_5.description: Grouped menu (Info/Actions/More), changelog announcements via changelog.json, multilingual support

G_priority_6.name: Intelligence: reminders + Tavily search
G_priority_6.description: Reminders system with APScheduler, Tavily web search in bot dialogue, progressive gardener learning via conversation

H_priority_7.name: Voice: Groq Whisper
H_priority_7.description: Voice message transcription via Groq Whisper API  text  SR dialogue

gardeners_private_repo.name: Move personal_gardeners/ to private repository
gardeners_private_repo.description: Create separate private repo mandala-gardeners. Move all personal_gardeners/ data there. Bot reads gardener data from GARDENERS_REPO env var, core data from CORE_REPO. Makes mandala-core fully open-source.
gardeners_private_repo.why_deferred: Low priority while only 1 active gardener. Adds complexity without benefit at current scale.
gardeners_private_repo.trigger: When 5+ real gardeners onboarded OR mandala-core goes public
gardeners_private_repo.implementation: Add repo param to _github_get/_github_put. Add GARDENERS_REPO env var. Migrate existing data.

hosting_migration.name: Migrate from Render to stable hosting
hosting_migration.description: Render free tier restarts randomly. Options: Railway ($5/mo), Hetzner CX23 (3.49eur/mo for 2+ services)
hosting_migration.why_deferred: v7.1.2+ with health endpoint + webhook auto-restore makes Render stable enough for MVP
hosting_migration.trigger: When 10+ gardeners OR instability returns after fixes
hosting_migration.recommended: Hetzner CX23 when 2+ services needed (bot + engineer-chat)

architecture.llm: OpenRouter  qwen3.5-flash-02-23 (1M ctx) with sliding window history (40 msgs)
architecture.memory: _sessions = {user_id: [messages]}  in-memory, trimmed at 40 messages, LOST on restart
architecture.store: In-memory _store + fire-and-forget GitHub sync every 2 min
architecture.context_budget: system_prompt(~800) + gardener_profile(~500) + history(~8K) + current_msg = ~10K per request

acceptance_criteria: Bot remembers conversation within session (sliding window 40 msgs)
Model chain auto-switches on rate limit  user never sees error
Free dialogue feels warm and natural, follows Ahimsa
Health endpoint returns 200, webhook auto-restores after restart
Each user sees only their own data (after Block B)
Conversation survives bot restart (after Block C)

health.notes: v7.1.2+ deployed and stable. Health endpoint added. Webhook auto-restore active. Main pending: multi-user (Block B)  critical before sharing with others.
